design_notes: Use a single accent colour (e.g. #003366) for table headers, pull-quote rule, and sidebar border.
Table: hairline rules between rows, bold header row, right-aligned numbers.
Pull-quote: set in a larger serif italic, with a thick left rule in accent colour.
Sidebar: box with a thin border, background tint at 5% of accent colour.
No icons, no images, no decorative elements.
